main_text.p: quas diuersi circularium linearum positus et connexus pariunt.
ἀμφίκυρτοι γωνίαι quas lineæ curuæ concauis sibi inuicem partibus obuersæ, conuexis ad exteriora uergentibus, includunt.
ἀμφίκοιλοι uel συσσφαιρικαὶ, quas eædem conuexis partibus se mutuo respicientes contiment, concauis ad exteriora uersis.
μιωοειδεῖς, quas earundem linearum mixti positus conformant, unius conuexo ad concauum alterius conuerso, ut in μιωϊσκοις.

page.notes: The figure shows curves labelled α, β, γ, δ, and three overlapping circles; the letter marks in red ink (a, β, γ, δ, ɛ) are reference letters beside the curves. Greek words in the last two paragraphs are partly illegible in the scan: "μιωοειδεῖς" and "μιωϊσκοις" are uncertain and marked by my reading only; the "ἀμφίκοιλοι" line and "συσσφαιρικαὶ" are doubtful. Catchword "Rea" is the partial signature/marginal mark at lower right of the figure, not text of the page.
